claim_boundary: Observed held-out-SKU transfer, not unreleased-hardware prediction.

records.protocol: All rows of the held-out SKU, including preprocessing fit, are excluded from training. Hardware-analogue selection uses only physical capability descriptors from training hardware profiles; its target estimate uses training rows only.

support.distance_definition: Root mean squared difference after min-max scaling across training hardware profiles, calculated only on shared nonmissing dimensions with nonzero training range.
support.generation_novelty: not assessed: Epoch fields do not provide a validated common generation taxonomy for these mapped SKUs.
